name: China Resources and Environment Co.,Ltd.
summary: China Resources and Environment Co.,Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise focused on the reclamation and deconstruction of discarded electronic and electrical goods within the country. The company primarily processes a range of consumer electronics, including televisions, washing machines, refrigerators, room air conditioning units, and microcomputers. These processed materials are then supplied to various downstream industries such as those manufacturing modified plastics, engaging in glass reprocessing, smelting recycled metals, and handling hazardous waste. Founded in 1996, the company maintains its headquarters in Beijing, China.
